(Japanese: 救世主あらわる！ The Saviors Appear!) is the 61st chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Yappy attempts to use Burst to fight back, but fails in the process.
Hariru and Carola return to help fight against Rovy and Ganku.
Hariru and Carola are seemingly defeated by Rovy and Ganku's combination attack.
